findings.finding: All original city-derived facility identities and opening hours were unverified. Names are now generic and explicitly fictional; opening hours/address cleared. Scene displays, calendar requests, products and route conditions are hypothetical only, not actual Minamata service information.
Corrected Park/Community Staff to supported Park/Park Staff.

Other supported input categories/jobs retained. Nurse receives a month/date-specific appointment request without confirming availability, physician schedules or safety of delay. Government staff routes distinct move/insurance questions without deciding eligibility. Police records bicycle observations without certifying theft. Bank refers existing-account status for checking rather than guaranteeing reuse or new opening.
